turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Thank you for making time.

I have twenty minutes. Then I have a client.

Owen got a zero. It was entered before you called me. I'd like to know why that order happened.

And I'd like to see exactly what you're relying on. The report itself, please. Not a summary.
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.

Good. Which three?

Give me titles and dates. Not impressions.

And what did you find? Did you compare them to the Hamlet essay? Side by side?

I'm not asking what you feel about them. I'm asking what's on the page.
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?

Some nights. His father too.

That's kind. It's also not evidence.

You said you reread three essays. I asked what you found. That's a compliment, not a finding.

So. Did the Hamlet essay differ from those three? How? Point to a passage.

And the checker. Which tool? What version? What does a 94% actually mean?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.

Thank you. I know who he is.

But you're still not answering me.

You entered a zero before you called. That's fifteen percent of his mark. So what did you have in your hand when you entered it?

The report. The tool. The date you ran it. Show me those.

And one more thing. Who else knows about this? Has anyone said a word to the class?
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.

I'm not here to fight, Mr. Hale.

But I notice that's the third time you've talked about feelings. And I still haven't seen a document.

Here's what I need. Today.

The report, in writing. Nothing said to the class. And the zero held, not entered, until this is reviewed.

You entered it first. So you can reverse that first.

Can you do that?
